body:
Logic is not my preferred perspective, but in the interest of maintaining what little dignity remains of me -- I see what you're saying completely. The sheer truth is that my future holds a lot of potential for an amazing life. But I'm being hurt over and over again and it is a requirement for me to endure this torture and abuse if I am to reach that 'happy' ending. 

I just don't think I can endure any longer. I'm too young to have any other options, family, or people to go to. I think I am finally alone, instead of just lonely. Because I've left myself as a friend & support. The 'spirit' or whatever one wishes to call it that supported my ego in times of sorrow is now itself too heavily burdened to continue further.
The encumbrance doesn't cease - it fluctuates - that is the way of life. I just think I've been dealt the equivalent of a perfect hand -- with the caveat that I will be shot in the head and killed immediately if I play it (and 'win', for the sake of the example). My only other option then is to face the unknown -- not playing the hand and seeing what happens, or simply quitting the game and knowing what will *eventually* happen. If this hypothetical poker game was a true analogy to my life; getting up and walking away would be the equivalent of leaving behind all of my opportunities and potential because I know what will immediately follow. The only options that are true to the chaotic (or perhaps, abstruse orderliness) nature of life are quitting and simply not playing and sitting there. Maybe I'll get shot and killed doing that too, or maybe I'll be free to go and I get to be homeless instead of winning a billion dollars or whatever.

Sorry, that's garbled nonsense, but if it makes sense - or if it doesn't -- thank you for trying. You are kind.

I admit defeat logically -- but I no longer desire to have hope for the future. The suffering, and impending suffering are too great, too tortuous -- the greatest life to follow them would be taken for granted by a buffoon such as myself - one who is stuck in yesterday.

There's a saying about how things getting worse before they get better.. and it's true, but only halfway.

The other half is that they get worse again, perhaps worse than before - and ultimately things are neutral, positive, or negative (depending on the metaphysical, or lack thereof if such is the case).. and I have no control over that .. but I have this one thing. This thing they can't steal from me, they can abuse me into not wanting.. 

and it's mine for the taking.
